resources.name: MantisBase API
resources.description: MantisBase REST API (`/api/v1/`). Import env vars, run Admin Login, copy token to admin_token.

resources.contents:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: MantisBase REST API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    OpenAPI specification for the MantisBase REST API (`/api/v1/`).

    MantisBase auto-generates CRUD endpoints for registered entities. Authorization on entity
    and realtime routes is evaluated per-entity via access rules (`public`, `auth`, `custom`, or
    admin-only empty mode) — not every route requires a Bearer token.

    **Credentials:** send JWTs or API keys (`mb_sk_...`) in the standard header:
    `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

    **Response envelope:** most JSON endpoints return `{ "status", "data", "error" }`.
    The health check is an exception (`{ "status": "OK" }`).

    Generated from route registrations in `src/core/` and `doc/api.md` / `doc/auth.md`.
  license:
    name: MIT
    url: https://github.com/allankoechke/mantisbase/blob/main/LICENSE

servers:
  - url: http://localhost:7070/api/v1
    description: Local development (default `mantisbase serve`)
  - url: http://localhost:7070/api/v1
    description: Docker default (`docker run -p 7070:80 ...`)

tags:
  - name: Health
  - name: Auth
    description: Entity user authentication, token verify, API keys, and OAuth
  - name: Entities
    description: Auto-generated CRUD for registered entities
  - name: Schemas
    description: Entity schema management (admin only)
  - name: Files
  - name: Realtime
    description: Server-Sent Events and WebSocket change notifications
  - name: System
    description: Admin accounts, logs, settings, system API keys, OAuth provider registry

security:
  - bearerAuth: []

paths:
  /health:
    get:
      tags: [Health]
      summary: Health check
      description: Lightweight liveness probe. Does not use the standard response envelope.
      security: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Server is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: OK
                required: [status]

  /auth/verify:
    get:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: Verify current credentials
      description: |
        Checks whether the current JWT or API key is valid. Rate-limited to 5 requests/minute per IP.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Token is valid
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          status:
                            type: string
                            example: OK
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /auth/{entity_name}/login:
    post:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: Entity user login
      description: |
        Authenticate against an auth-type entity and receive a JWT. Rate-limited to 5 attempts/minute per IP.
        The entity must be type `auth`, API-enabled, and not a system entity.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/LoginRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Login successful
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/AuthTokenResponse"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "429":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/TooManyRequests"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /auth/{entity_name}/refresh:
    post:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: Refresh entity user token
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Token refreshed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/AuthTokenResponse"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /auth/{entity_name}/logout:
    post:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: Logout entity user
      description: Invalidates the current session when the JWT contains a `session_id` claim.
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Logged out
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          logged_out:
                            type: boolean
                            example: true
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /auth/{entity_name}/api-keys:
    get:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: List entity user API keys
      description: Returns metadata only; raw secrets are never included in list responses.
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: API key list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiKeyMetadata"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"
    post:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: Create entity user API key
      description: Returns the raw `mb_sk_...` secret once at creation time.
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiKeyCreateRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: API key created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiKeyCreated"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /auth/{entity_name}/api-keys/{id}:
    delete:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: Revoke entity user API key
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/ResourceId"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Key revoked
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          deleted:
                            type: boolean
                            example: true
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /auth/{entity_name}/oauth/authorize/{provider}:
    get:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: Start OAuth login (redirect)
      description: Redirects the browser to the OAuth provider authorization URL (PKCE).
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/OAuthProvider"
        - name: redirect_uri
          in: query
          description: Callback URL. Defaults to the server callback route when omitted.
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uri
      responses:
        "302":
          description: Redirect to provider
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"

  /auth/{entity_name}/oauth/callback/{provider}:
    get:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: OAuth callback
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/OAuthProvider"
        - name: code
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: state
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: error
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OAuth login succeeded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        description: OAuth result (typically includes JWT token and user record)
                        type: object
                        additionalProperties: true
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"

  /auth/{entity_name}/oauth/link/{provider}:
    post:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: Link OAuth provider to current user
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/OAuthProvider"
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                code:
                  type: string
                state:
                  type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Provider linked
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
    delete:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: Unlink OAuth provider from current user
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/OAuthProvider"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Provider unlinked
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          unlinked:
                            type: boolean
                            example: true
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /auth/{entity_name}/oauth/accounts:
    get:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: List linked OAuth accounts
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Linked accounts
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          additionalProperties: true
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /auth/{entity_name}/oauth/providers:
    get:
      tags: [Auth]
      summary: List OAuth providers enabled for entity
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/EntityName"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Enabled providers
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          additionalProperties: true
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /entities/{entity_name}:
    get:
      tags: [Entities]
      summary: List entity records
      description: Authorization depends on the entity `list` access rule. Results are ordered by record `id` ascending.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DynamicEntityName"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Limit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/AfterCursor"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Filter"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Paginated record list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntityListPage"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"
    post:
      tags: [Entities]
      summary: Create entity record
      description: Authorization depends on the entity `add` access rule. Supports JSON and multipart file uploads.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DynamicEntityName"
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntityRecord"
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: true
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Record created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntityRecord"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /entities/{entity_name}/{id}:
    get:
      tags: [Entities]
      summary: Get entity record
      description: Authorization depends on the entity `get` access rule.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DynamicEntityName"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/ResourceId"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Record found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntityRecord"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"
    patch:
      tags: [Entities]
      summary: Update entity record
      description: Authorization depends on the entity `update` access rule. View entities reject mutations.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DynamicEntityName"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/ResourceId"
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntityRecord"
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: true
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Record updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntityRecord"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"
    delete:
      tags: [Entities]
      summary: Delete entity record
      description: Authorization depends on the entity `delete` access rule.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DynamicEntityName"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/ResourceId"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Record deleted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /schemas:
    get:
      tags: [Schemas]
      summary: List all schemas
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Schema list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntitySchema"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"
    post:
      tags: [Schemas]
      summary: Create schema
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntitySchemaCreate"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Schema created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntitySchema"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /schemas/{schema_name_or_id}:
    get:
      tags: [Schemas]
      summary: Get schema
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/SchemaNameOrId"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Schema details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntitySchema"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"
    patch:
      tags: [Schemas]
      summary: Update schema
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/SchemaNameOrId"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntitySchemaPatch"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Schema updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntitySchema"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"
    delete:
      tags: [Schemas]
      summary: Delete schema
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/SchemaNameOrId"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Schema deleted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /files/{entity}/{file}:
    get:
      tags: [Files]
      summary: Serve uploaded file
      description: Returns the stored file for a given entity upload field.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - name: entity
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: file
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: File content
          content:
            application/octet-stream:
              schema:
                type: string
                format: binary
        "404":
          description: File not found

  /realtime:
    get:
      tags: [Realtime]
      summary: Open SSE connection
      description: |
        Establishes a long-lived Server-Sent Events stream. Disabled when `MB_REALTIME_SSE=false`.

        Subscribing to `entity` requires list access; subscribing to `entity:row_id` requires get access.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - name: topics
          in: query
          required: true
          description: Comma-separated topics (`posts`, `users`, `posts:019c...`).
          schema:
            type: string
            example: posts,users,posts:019c1b81-364b-7000-8120-b5416b2c42c2
      responses:
        "200":
          description: SSE stream
          content:
            text/event-stream:
              schema:
                type: string
                description: |
                  SSE events: `connected`, `ping`, and `change`.
                  Each `data:` line contains JSON matching `RealtimeChangeEvent` or connection metadata.
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "503":
          description: SSE disabled
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
    post:
      tags: [Realtime]
      summary: Update SSE session topics
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RealtimeSessionUpdate"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Topics updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          client_id:
                            type: string
                          topics:
                            type: array
                            items:
                              type: string
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"

  /realtime/ws:
    get:
      tags: [Realtime]
      summary: WebSocket realtime connection
      description: |
        WebSocket endpoint at `WS /api/v1/realtime/ws`.

        After connecting, send JSON messages such as `{ "topics": ["posts", "users"] }`.
        Change events use the same payload shape as SSE `change` events.
        Disabled when `MB_REALTIME_WS=false`.
      security: []
      responses:
        "101":
          description: Switching Protocols (WebSocket upgrade)

  /sys/admins/login:
    post:
      tags: [System]
      summary: Admin login
      description: Rate-limited to 5 attempts/minute per IP.
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/LoginRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Admin login successful
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/AuthTokenResponse"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "429":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/TooManyRequests"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /sys/admins/refresh:
    post:
      tags: [System]
      summary: Refresh admin token
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Token refreshed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: "#/components/schemas/AuthTokenResponse"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /sys/admins/logout:
    post:
      tags: [System]
      summary: Admin logout
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Logged out
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          logged_out:
                            type: boolean
                            example: true
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalError"

  /sys/admins/setup:
    post:
      tags: [System]
      summary: Create initial admin account
      description: |

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT or mb_sk_ API key
      description: |
        JWT from login/refresh, or a long-lived API key prefixed with `mb_sk_`.
        Both use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

  parameters:
    EntityName:
      name: entity_name
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Auth-type entity name (not a system entity).
      schema:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,64}$"
        example: users
    DynamicEntityName:
      name: entity_name
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Registered entity name.
      schema:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,64}$"
        example: posts
    SchemaNameOrId:
      name: schema_name_or_id
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    ResourceId:
      name: id
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    OAuthProvider:
      name: provider
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        example: google
    Limit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        maximum: 500
        default: 50
    AfterCursor:
      name: after
      in: query
      schema:
        type: string
      description: Cursor (`id` of the last item from the previous page).
    Filter:
      name: filter
      in: query
      schema:
        type: string
      description: "URL-encoded JSON object of `{field: value}` equality filters."

  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: Invalid request
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
    Unauthorized:
      description: Missing, invalid, or expired credentials
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
    Forbidden:
      description: Authenticated but not permitted
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
    NotFound:
      description: Resource not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
    InternalError:
      description: Server error
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
    TooManyRequests:
      description: Rate limit exceeded
      headers:
        Retry-After:
          schema:
            type: integer
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"
    ServiceUnavailable:
      description: Route temporarily disabled (e.g. env gate)
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiEnvelope"

  schemas:
    ApiEnvelope:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: integer
        data:
          description: Payload; shape varies by endpoint.
        error:
          oneOf:
            - type: string
            - type: "null"
      required: [status, data, error]

    LoginRequest:
      type: object
      required: [identity, password]
      properties:
        identity:
          type: string
          description: Email address or user ID
          example: user@example.com
        password:
          type: string
          format: password

    AuthTokenResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        token:
          type: string
          description: JWT access token
        user:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntityRecord"
      required: [token, user]

    EntityRecord:
      type: object
      description: Dynamic record shape defined by entity schema.
      additionalProperties: true

    EntityListPage:
      type: object
      properties:
        items_count:
          type: integer
        limit:
          type: integer
        has_more:
          type: boolean
        cursor:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntityRecord"

    LogEntry:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        level:
          type: string
          enum: [trace, debug, info, warn, critical]
        origin:
          type: string
        message:
          type: string
        details:
          type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    LogListPage:
      type: object
      properties:
        items_count:
          type: integer
        limit:
          type: integer
        has_more:
          type: boolean
        cursor:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/LogEntry"

    ApiKeyCreateRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        label:
          type: string
          default: API Key
          example: Mobile app
        permissions:
          type: array
          description: Stored metadata only; not enforced by middleware today.
          items: {}
          default: []
        expires_at:
          type: string
          description: Optional UTC expiration timestamp. Empty or omitted means no expiration.
          default: ""

    ApiKeyCreated:
      allOf:
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiKeyMetadata"
        - type: object
          properties:
            key:
              type: string
              description: Raw secret shown once (`mb_sk_...`).
              example: mb_sk_a1b2c3d4...

    ApiKeyMetadata:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        entity_name:
          type: string
        user_id:
          type: string
        label:
          type: string
        permissions:
          type: array
          items: {}
        last_used:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        created:
          type: string
        expires_at:
          type: string
          nullable: true

    AccessRule:
      type: object
      properties:
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: ["", public, auth, custom]
        expr:
          type: string

    EntitySchema:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [base, auth, view]
        fields:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: true
        rules:
          type: object
          properties:
            list:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AccessRule"
            get:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AccessRule"
            add:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AccessRule"
            update:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AccessRule"
            delete:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AccessRule"
        view_query:
          type: string
          description: Required for `view` entities.
      additionalProperties: true

    EntitySchemaCreate:
      type: object
      required: [name, type]
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,64}$"
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [base, auth, view]
        fields:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: true
        rules:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/AccessRule"
        view_query:
          type: string

    EntitySchemaPatch:
      type: object
      properties:
        fields:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: true
            description: 'Add by name, update by id, delete with op "delete".'
        rules:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/AccessRule"
        view_query:
          type: string

    AppSettings:
      type: object
      properties:
        orgName:
          type: string
          example: ACME Corp
        siteDomain:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: Public site URL (OAuth callbacks, links, JWT audience)
        maxFileSize:
          type: integer
          description: Maximum upload size in bytes
          example: 10485760
        allowRegistration:
          type: boolean
        emailVerificationRequired:
          type: boolean
        sessionTimeout:
          type: integer
          description: Entity user session timeout in seconds
        adminSessionTimeout:
          type: integer
          description: Admin session timeout in seconds
        jwtEnableSetIssuer:
          type: boolean
        jwtEnableSetAudience:
          type: boolean
        smtp:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/SmtpConfig"
        mantisVersion:
          type: string
          readOnly: true

    AppSettingsPatch:
      type: object
      description: Partial update; omitted fields retain current values.
      properties:
        orgName:
          type: string
        siteDomain:
          type: string
        maxFileSize:
          type: integer
          description: Maximum upload size in bytes
        allowRegistration:
          type: boolean
        emailVerificationRequired:
          type: boolean
        sessionTimeout:
          type: integer
        adminSessionTimeout:
          type: integer
        jwtEnableSetIssuer:
          type: boolean
        jwtEnableSetAudience:
          type: boolean
        smtp:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/SmtpConfigPatch"

    SmtpConfig:
      type: object
      properties:
        host:
          type: string
        port:
          type: integer
          example: 587
        user:
          type: string
        password:
          type: string
          writeOnly: true
        from:
          type: string
        tls:
          type: boolean

    SmtpConfigPatch:
      type: object
      description: Partial SMTP update. Send `"********"` for password to keep the existing value.
      properties:
        host:
          type: string
        port:
          type: integer
        user:
          type: string
        password:
          type: string
        from:
          type: string
        tls:
          type: boolean

    OAuthProvider:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: true

    OAuthProviderCreate:
      type: object
      required: [name, client_id, client_secret]
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          example: google
        client_id:
          type: string
        client_secret:
          type: string
          format: password

    OAuthEntityConfig:
      type: object
      required: [entity_name, provider_id]
      properties:
        entity_name:
          type: string
        provider_id:
          type: string

    RealtimeSessionUpdate:
      type: object
      required: [client_id, topics]
      properties:
        client_id:
          type: string
          description: Session ID from the SSE `connected` event
        topics:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: Entity names or `entity:row_id` strings. Empty array clears subscriptions.

    RealtimeChangeEvent:
      type: object
      properties:
        action:
          type: string
          enum: [insert, update, delete]
        entity:
          type: string
        row_id:
          type: string
        topic:
          type: string
        timestamp:
          type: integer
        data:
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/EntityRecord"
            - type: "null"

resources.name: GET Verify current credentials
resources.description: Checks whether the current JWT or API key is valid. Rate-limited to 5 requests/minute per IP.

resources.name: GET List entity user API keys
resources.description: Returns metadata only; raw secrets are never included in list responses.

resources.name: POST Create entity user API key
resources.description: Returns the raw `mb_sk_...` secret once at creation time.

resources.name: DELETE Revoke entity user API key
POST Entity user login
resources.description:
Authenticate against an auth-type entity and receive a JWT. Rate-limited to 5 attempts/minute per IP.
The entity must be type `auth`, API-enabled, and not a system entity.

resources.name: POST Logout entity user
resources.description: Invalidates the current session when the JWT contains a `session_id` claim.

resources.name: GET Start OAuth login (redirect)
resources.description: Redirects the browser to the OAuth provider authorization URL (PKCE).

resources.name: POST Link OAuth provider to current user
DELETE Unlink OAuth provider from current user
GET List OAuth providers enabled for entity
GET List entity records
resources.description: Authorization depends on the entity `list` access rule. Results are ordered by record `id` ascending.

resources.name: POST Create entity record
resources.description: Authorization depends on the entity `add` access rule. Supports JSON and multipart file uploads.

resources.name: GET Get entity record
resources.description: Authorization depends on the entity `get` access rule.

resources.name: PATCH Update entity record
resources.description: Authorization depends on the entity `update` access rule. View entities reject mutations.

resources.name: DELETE Delete entity record
resources.description: Authorization depends on the entity `delete` access rule.

resources.name: GET Serve uploaded file
resources.description: Returns the stored file for a given entity upload field.

resources.name: GET Health check
resources.description: Lightweight liveness probe. Does not use the standard response envelope.

resources.name: GET Open SSE connection
resources.description:
Establishes a long-lived Server-Sent Events stream. Disabled when `MB_REALTIME_SSE=false`.

Subscribing to `entity` requires list access; subscribing to `entity:row_id` requires get access.

resources.name: GET WebSocket realtime connection
resources.description:
WebSocket endpoint at `WS /api/v1/realtime/ws`.

After connecting, send JSON messages such as `{ "topics": ["posts", "users"] }`.
Change events use the same payload shape as SSE `change` events.
Disabled when `MB_REALTIME_WS=false`.

resources.name: POST Create admin account
resources.description: Blocked with 503 when `MB_DISABLE_ADMIN_MUTATIONS` is truthy.

resources.name: POST Admin login
resources.description: Rate-limited to 5 attempts/minute per IP.

resources.name: POST Create initial admin account
resources.description:
First-boot setup. Requires a valid service-account token (`mb_service_acc` entity).
Rate-limited to 3 requests/hour per IP.

resources.name: PATCH Update admin account
resources.description: Blocked with 503 when `MB_DISABLE_ADMIN_MUTATIONS` is truthy.

resources.name: DELETE Delete admin account
resources.description: Blocked with 503 when `MB_DISABLE_ADMIN_MUTATIONS` is truthy.

resources.name: POST Enable OAuth provider for entity
DELETE Disable OAuth provider for entity
PATCH Update application settings
resources.description: Blocked with HTTP 503 when environment variable `MB_DISABLE_CONFIG_MUTATIONS` is set to a truthy value.
